messages: Ha ha ha... You'll never beat me by reflecting my lightning bolts and unleashing the arrows from Deku Tree!
Ha ha ha... You'll never defeat me, drop a castle on me and finish me off with the sacred blade from Gerudo's Fortress!
Ha ha ha... You'll never beat me by reflecting my lightning bolts and unleashing the arrows from Deku Tree! And even if you do, you'll never find the legendary blade hidden in Gerudo's Fortress!

Ganondorf Joke.message:
What about Zelda makes you think
she'd be a better ruler than I? I saved Lon Lon Ranch,
fed the hungry,
and my castle floats.

Sheik in Ganons Castle Hint.message: I overheard Ganondorf say that he misplaced the Light Arrows in Deku Tree.

Dampe's Diary Hint.message:
Whoever reads this, please enter Goron City. I will let you have my stretching, shrinking keepsake. I'm waiting for you.
--Dampé

Treasure Chest Game Greg Hint.message:
By the way, if you're interested, I saw the shiniest Green Rupee somewhere in Zora's Fountain. It's said to have mysterious powers... But then, it could just be another regular rupee.
Oh well.

ToT Altar as Child.message:
3 Spiritual Stones found in Hyrule... Kokiri Forest... Spirit Temple... Kokiri Forest... Ye who may become a Hero...
The path to the future is open...

ToT Altar as Adult.message: An awakening voice from the Sacred Realm will call those destined to be Sages, who dwell in the five temples. Kokiri Forest... Goron City... Death Mountain Crater... Desert Colossus... The Thieves' Hideout... Spirit Temple... The awakened ones will await for the Hero to find Greg. And the evil one's key will be kept in a big chest inside its tower. And the Triforce will be granted once 25 Triforce Pieces are retrieved. Together with the Hero of Time, the awakened ones will return the light of peace to the world...
